description: We are Team four_phantoms, a passionate team of technology and space enthusiasts participating in the NASA Hackathon. We are interested in space exploration, innovation, web development, and solving real-world challenges using technology and NASA data. We believe in teamwork, creativity, and building impactful solutions. We are looking for enthusiastic members skilled in coding, AI/ML, UI/UX design, research, and problem-solving who want to create something amazing together!
